home.title: Quest Chermside | Chermside Serviced Apartment | Chermside Accommodation
home.metaDesc: We’re passionate about offering you a unique stay with excellent customer service – all set within an ideal location.
home.text: Add promo or corporate code Login FIND A HOTEL OFFERS PLAN YOUR TRIP STAY YOUR WAY DOING BETTER ABOUT QUEST REWARDS QLD / Chermside Quest Chermside Accessible Accessible Accredited 9 Thomas Street Chermside, Chermside +61 7 3363 0100 Contact Us Have a promo or corporate code? Pairing warm service with convenience Earn Qantas points Choose Quest Chermside for a prime position just 15 minutes from Brisbane Airport and nearby Sandgate-Brighton Foreshore, as well as the conveniences of dining, shopping, and entertainment across the road at Westfield Chermside – one of Brisbane's largest shopping centres. The convenience of our location is matched with the luxury of our spacious, stylishly serviced apartments – meaning you can enjoy a true getaway experience. Our 54 light-filled accommodation options come equipped with kitchenettes through to full-sized kitchens and laundry facilities and attract couples, families and those on business. But it's the customer service that keeps guests coming back. We're passionate about providing a unique experience and making sure your stay with us is truly carefree. In terms of accessibility, our property and accessible rooms have been independently accredited for the needs of independent wheelchair users who can self transfer from a bed or toilet and also those people with reduced mobility that use a cane or walking frame. For more information on our accessible amenities and features, please click here. Amenities: Conference Facilities Broadband
